managePosition(address,address,uint256,b.details: Manages the position on behalf of a given borrower.

params.collateralChange: The amount of collateral to add or remove.
params.collateralToken: The token the borrower used as collateral.
params.debtChange: The amount of R to add or remove. In case of repayment (isDebtIncrease = false) `type(uint256).max` value can be used to repay the whole outstanding loan.
params.isCollateralIncrease: True if the collateral is being increased, false otherwise.
params.isDebtIncrease: True if the debt is being increased, false otherwise.
params.maxFeePercentage: The maximum fee percentage to pay for the position management.
params.permitSignature: Optional permit signature for tokens that support IERC20Permit interface.

returns.actualCollateralChange: Actual amount of collateral added/removed. Can be different to `collateralChange` in case of full repayment.
returns.actualDebtChange: Actual amount of debt added/removed. Can be different to `debtChange` in case of passing type(uint256).max as `debtChange`.
